author: Aspire Starter Platform
name: Aspire Vertical Slice Platform
description: Creates a .NET Aspire solution with a Wolverine HTTP service, vertical slices, EF Core on PostgreSQL, Keycloak authentication, Redis output cache, RFC 9457 problem details, URL-segment API versioning, and unit plus Aspire integration tests. The solution name and the service name are chosen independently.

ServiceName.description: Name of the service created inside the solution. Independent of the solution name.

choices.description: Keycloak container started by the AppHost, with an imported realm
Microsoft Entra ID. Set TenantId and Audience in appsettings before running

AuthProvider.description: Identity provider wired into the service and the AppHost.

KeycloakPort.description: Host port Keycloak listens on during local development.

CorsOrigin.description: First trusted CORS origin. The service refuses to start with an empty allow list.

skipRestore.description: Skip the automatic restore after the solution is created.

manualInstructions.text:
1. Start everything with 'dotnet run --project src/App/App.AppHost'.
2. Sign in to Keycloak with developer / developer, or edit src/App/App.AppHost/Keycloak/starter-realm.json.
3. Add another service from src/Services with 'dotnet new aspire-service -n <ServiceName>'.
4. Regenerate Wolverine code after changing an endpoint signature: 'dotnet run --project src/Services/<ServiceName> --no-launch-profile -- codegen write'.
